title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up on pressure ulcer.

HPI
Pt is a 76-year-old female presenting for wound care of a pressure ulcer on the right heel. Pt reports the wound remains painful. No new drainage noted. Pt reports compliance with offloading measures.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
General: Alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: Pressure ulcer on the right heel. Wound base is covered by eschar, making the wound unstageable. No surrounding erythema or purulent drainage noted.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Pressure ulcer on right heel.

Plan
1. Wound care: Cleanse with normal saline, apply hydrogel and non-adherent dressing.
2. Continue offloading and repositioning.
3. F/u in 2 weeks for wound assessment.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
10/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the right heel, unstageable (base covered by eschar or slough): L89.610 (HCC 381).

distractors.why: Unstageable is a documented stage (L89.--0), not 'unspecified'.
Do not assign a stage the provider could not determine.

hccs.label: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Full Thickness Skin Loss
